items.a: Yes! TaskFlow offers a comprehensive free tier designed for individuals and small teams. It includes unlimited projects, up to 5 collaborators, and all essential Kanban views without expiration or sneaky trial periods.

items.q: Can I invite teammates to collaborate?
items.a: Absolutely. You can invite teammates with a simple invite link or email invite. Assign roles, collaborate on boards in real time, and assign tasks with instant notifications.

items.q: Is my project and task data secure?
items.a: Data security is our top priority. All database communication is encrypted using industry-standard TLS 1.3 and stored with AES-256 encryption at rest. We never sell or train public models on your private data.

items.q: Does TaskFlow work well on mobile?
items.a: Yes, TaskFlow is built responsive-first. You can view, edit, and move cards easily from any mobile browser with smooth touch gestures.
